GoalOptions.Label: Inform & Validate
GoalOptions.Text: The reader can understand the AI-Assisted Code Review & Security Gate's technical architecture, its integration into CI/CD, and its value proposition for enhancing code quality and security. They should be able to validate its alignment with strategic technology goals.

GoalOptions.Label: Approve & Support
GoalOptions.Text: The reader can grasp the strategic importance of the AI-Assisted Code Review & Security Gate, its impact on development velocity and security posture, and be prepared to approve necessary resources or provide executive support for its adoption and scaling.

GoalOptions.Label: Understand & Evaluate
GoalOptions.Text: The reader can understand the solution's core capabilities in detecting vulnerabilities, architectural anti-patterns, and performance regressions. They should be able to evaluate its effectiveness in improving developer workflows and overall software quality.

GoalOptions.Label: Align & Prioritize
GoalOptions.Text: The reader can understand how the AI-Assisted Code Review & Security Gate aligns with our broader technology strategy and security initiatives. They should be able to prioritize its implementation and integration within the existing software development lifecycle.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical Efficacy & Integration
Criteria: Clearly articulates how the LLM-powered static analysis tool integrates into existing CI/CD pipelines.
Demonstrates the solution's accuracy in detecting OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities and architectural anti-patterns.
Explains the mechanism for providing low-latency PR feedback and fix suggestions.
Addresses scalability and robustness for enterprise-level codebases and development teams.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Strategic Value & ROI
Criteria: Quantifies the potential reduction in security incidents and technical debt due to early detection.
Highlights the improvement in developer productivity and code quality metrics.
Outlines the cost savings associated with automated code review compared to manual processes.
Presents a clear path for adoption and the expected timeline for realizing benefits.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Risk Mitigation & Compliance
Criteria: Details how the solution enhances compliance with industry security standards (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001).
Explains the process for minimizing false positives and negatives in vulnerability detection.
Addresses data privacy and intellectual property concerns related to LLM-powered code analysis.
Outlines the strategy for continuous improvement and adaptation to evolving threat landscapes.
